title: Breach Baby...Breach!!!
description: This is a video showing some of the procedures required to emplace a Bangalore Torpedo with the purpose of breaching an obstacle. Employing the mine are members of the 91st Engineer Battalion, 1st Armored Brigade Combat Team, 1st Cavalry Division. A portion of the battalion is currently operating in Bulgaria along with 2-5 CAV of the same Brigade. These are highly trained professionals displaying Violence of Action. Enjoy!!
